user.title: Choose your purifier
user.description: Pick the unit to add. It must be powered on and in Bluetooth range.

setup.title: Model and key
setup.description: Unit at {address}. The vendor's servers are gone, so this integration cannot pair a unit by itself. Paste the 16-byte local key from a phone that was already paired to this purifier (base64 like `AbC...==`, or 32 hex characters).

data.protocol_number: Protocol number (hex) - leave the default unless told otherwise

error.bad_key: That is not a valid 16-byte key (base64 or 32 hex characters), or the protocol number is not hex.
error.not_in_range: Home Assistant cannot see this purifier right now. Move a Bluetooth adapter or proxy closer.
error.cannot_connect: Connected, but the purifier did not answer. Try again.
error.invalid_auth: The purifier rejected this key. It belongs to a different unit or slot.

abort.no_devices_found: No purifiers found. Make sure it is powered on and in range.
abort.already_configured: This purifier is already set up.
